text: てんいんが　おしえる　わざだけに　カウンター！

structure.jp: てんいんが　おしえる　わざだけに
structure.en: precisely because it's a move a shop clerk teaches

patterns.name: 〜だけに
patterns.explanation: だけに means 'precisely because it is that', leading into something that fits naturally; here it sets up the joke that a clerk stands at a counter. わざだけに = 'precisely because it's a move'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: てんいんが　おしえる　わざ
patterns.explanation: A short sentence placed right before a thing describes that thing, like English 'that...'. てんいんが　おしえる　わざ = 'a move that a shop clerk teaches'.
